name: Clean-slate student, theoretical computer science track
description: Seventh track. No internal hard prerequisite edges. The most extreme single-area concentration of any track: all 8 modules are theoretical_cs, so cp_by_area has exactly one key -- real, not a bug, since this track is literally named after that one area. Only 1 of the needed 3 areas ever meets the minimum, no matter what's passed, because the track itself never touches a second area at all -- a structurally different kind of 'not satisfied' than any other track's.
